pages.title: <session title> (fallback "Chat")
pages.purpose: Second half of _ChatScreenState (lines 3801-7486): build(), app bar actions, transcript wiring, attention region, composer wiring, message actions, session menu dispatch and slash-command execution. Page header is emitted by b1.

elements.label: [system back / app bar back]
elements.effect: PopScope(canPop: _conn.isIsolated || _allowRoutePop) intercepts back and runs _leaveChat(): _persistDraft(); if the save fails opens the leave-unsaved-draft confirm sheet; then _discardUntouchedMobileSession() (api.deleteSession for an untouched provisional session when widget.discardIfUntouched) and Navigator.maybePop().
gates: confirm sheet only when _persistDraft() returns false

elements.label: Stop reading aloud
elements.effect: Calls _stopReading() (chat/read_aloud.dart:54): bumps the request counter, resets voice-reply state and stops the read-aloud player.

elements.label: Tasks · {count} running (narrow: badge icon; wide: "Tasks" text button)
elements.effect: Calls _openRunningWork() (line 834): showRunningWorkSheet for this session family; a returned session id opens that subagent via _openSubagentSession -> pushReplacementNamed(/chat/<id>); then reloads running shells. Wide layout variant is a TextButton.icon at line 6487 with the same key.
gates: IconButton when MediaQuery width < _titleBarWide, else TextButton.icon

elements.label: Review changes
elements.effect: Calls _showDiff(): in isolated (demo) mode loads api.diff(sessionID) and pushes DiffView(allowCopy: false).

elements.label: Session menu
elements.effect: Calls _openSessionMenu(reverted: session?.reverted == true, shared: shareUrl != null), which shows SessionMenuSheet in a modal bottom sheet and dispatches the returned action string (the single overflow of the chat app bar).

elements.label: Review changes
elements.effect: Calls _showDiff(): isolated demo path pushes DiffView(diffs, allowCopy: false).

elements.label: [connection status banner + queued drafts note]
elements.effect: Embeds ConnectionStatusBanner(controller: _conn, note: _queuedNote()); its own buttons live in lib/ui/widgets/connection_status_banner.dart.

elements.label: [dismiss prompt error]
elements.effect: onDismiss wired into _PromptErrorBanner (chat/message_view.dart:3): setState(() => _promptError = null).

elements.label: [choose model] (prompt error banner)
elements.effect: onChooseModel wired into _PromptErrorBanner: showModelPicker(context, applyScope: ModelPickerApplyScope.session, sessionID).

elements.label: [open parent session] (subagent context banner)
elements.effect: onParent wired into _SubagentContextBanner: _openParentSession() -> _openSubagentSession(parentID) -> _openRelatedSession: persists the draft, switches location via _conn.selectLocationForExistingSession when needed and pushReplacementNamed(/chat/<parentID>).

elements.label: [all subagents] (subagent context banner)
elements.effect: onAll wired into _SubagentContextBanner: _showSubagents() pushes SessionRelationsScreen; a returned Session is opened with _openRelatedSession (pushReplacementNamed /chat/<id>).

elements.label: [stop sharing] (shared session banner)
elements.effect: onStop wired into _SharedSessionBanner(url): _stopSharing() -> repository.unshareSession(sessionID), clears _localShareUrl, _conn.refreshSessions(), snackbar "Session is no longer shared". No confirmation.

elements.label: Review
elements.effect: Calls _reviewStagedRevert(): pushes StagedRevertScreen(controller: _conn, sessionID). Strip text: "Revert staged".

elements.label: [Retry] (ProductErrorState)
elements.effect: onRetry wired into ProductErrorState: _load() re-fetches the transcript.

elements.label: [find in conversation bar: query, next, previous, close, search all history, cancel loading]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _TranscriptFindBar (chat/transcript_find.dart): onChanged -> _changeFind, onNext/onPrevious -> _navigateFind(+1/-1), onClose -> _closeFind, onLoadOlder -> _searchAllHistory, onCancelLoading -> setState(_findAllLoading = false).

elements.label: <suggestion prompt> (empty transcript)
elements.effect: onSuggestion wired into _EmptyTranscript: _insertSuggestion(text) puts the suggestion into the composer.

elements.label: <file path mentioned in markdown>
elements.effect: MarkdownFileLinks(validate: _validatePathLink, open: _openPathLink): validates the path with api.listFiles(dir) (memoized, 20 s negative TTL); tap loads api.fileContent(path) and opens showFilePreviewSheet with onAttach -> _attachProjectFile(path, data).

elements.label: [scroll transcript]
elements.effect: NotificationListener<ScrollNotification> -> _onTranscriptScroll (line 3708): tracks _awayFromLatest / loads older history.

elements.label: <v2 subagent/task row>
elements.effect: onOpenChild wired into V2TranscriptRow: _openSubagentSession(id, requireChild: true) -> fetches the session if unknown (repository.getSessionDetails) and pushReplacementNamed(/chat/<id>) via _openRelatedSession.

elements.label: <transcript message> (long-press)
elements.effect: onLongPress wired into _MessageView: _showMessageActions(m) opens the message actions bottom sheet.

elements.label: <transcript message> (desktop right-click)
elements.effect: contextActions wired into _MessageView: opens the desktop context menu built by _messageContextActions(m) (line 3927); entries are the message-menu-* items below.

elements.label: Copy message text | Copy reply so far | Copy loaded reply | Copy complete reply
elements.effect: _copyMessageText(message): copies _messageCopy(message).text (adjacent assistant messages are joined into one reply) and shows snackbar "Message text copied".

elements.label: Fork from this prompt
elements.effect: _forkFromMessage(message): repository.forkSession(sessionID, messageID), _conn.refreshSessions(), then pushReplacement ChatScreen(sessionID: newId, initialText: prompt text, initialAttachments: prompt files).

elements.label: Revert from this prompt
elements.effect: _stageFromMessage(message): showStageRevertSheet(review, prompt); on confirm _conn.stageSessionRevert(review, messageID, applyFiles) then pushes StagedRevertScreen.
gates: _canStageFrom(message): _conn.supportsStagedRevert && !sessionRevertSaving && session not busy && user message && not local-/inbox item

elements.label: Delete message
elements.effect: _deleteMessage(message): opens the delete confirm sheet.

elements.label: <tool output file> preview/attach/download (inside _MessageView)
elements.effect: Host callbacks for tool-output files: filePreviewLoader -> _loadToolOutputFile (api.fileContent(path)); onAttachFile -> _attachToolOutputFile (adds a data: PromptAttachment, composer note "{filename} attached. Add your comment."; null when !_supportsPromptAttachments); onDownloadFile -> _downloadToolOutputFile (FilePicker.saveFile, snackbar "{filename} saved to your device.").

elements.label: [Compact] (context-overflow error card in _MessageView)
elements.effect: onCompact -> _compact(): repository.compactSession(sessionID, providerID, modelID); snackbar "Compaction started"; requires a selected model unless _conn.serverOwnsSessionSelection.

elements.label: [Open providers] (provider-auth error card in _MessageView)
elements.effect: onOpenProviders -> _openProviders(): pushes IntegrationsScreen(controller: _conn).

elements.label: Continue (output-length cut card in _MessageView)
elements.effect: onContinue -> _continueTruncated(): sets the composer to "Continue", calls _send(), then restores any half-typed draft.

elements.label: [Choose model] (model error card in _MessageView)
elements.effect: onChooseModel -> showModelPicker(context, applyScope: session, sessionID).

elements.label: <Task tool card> open subagent session (in _MessageView)
elements.effect: onOpenSession -> _openSubagentSession(sessionID): resolves the child session and pushReplacementNamed(/chat/<id>) via _openRelatedSession (draft persisted, location switched first).

elements.label: [jump to latest]
elements.effect: _JumpToLatestButton.onTap -> _jumpToLatest() (line 3765): scrolls the transcript to the newest message.

elements.label: [{count} earlier messages]
elements.effect: _EarlierMessagesPill.onTap -> _openTimeline(): shows _TimelineSheet; selection jumps to the message, opens find with the query, or forks from a prompt.

elements.label: Close (note receipt: "Note saved"/"Note removed. Applies at the next agent step.")
elements.effect: _conn.dismissSessionNoteReceipt(sessionID).

elements.label: [inline question card: answer]
elements.effect: onAnswer wired into _QuestionAttentionCard: _answerQuestion(question, answers) -> _conn.answerQuestion(question.id, answers).

elements.label: [More / Answer] (question card)
elements.effect: onMore -> _showQuestionSheet(question) -> showQuestionSheet(context, _conn, question) (activity_screen.dart:936).

elements.label: [retry backoff card]
elements.effect: Displays _RetryAttentionCard(retry: _retryState); countdown driven by _syncRetryTicker. No host callback.

elements.label: [automatic approvals indicator]
elements.effect: onOpen -> showSessionApprovalsSheet(context, controller: _conn, sessionID).

elements.label: [permission request card: Review]
elements.effect: onReview -> _showPermissionDialog(permission) -> showPermissionSheet(context, permission, controller: _conn, onShowSource: jump to the tool message via _jumpToMessage). One at a time (_activePermissionID guard).

elements.label: <form title | "Input requested"> · {count} questions
elements.effect: _FormRequestCard InkWell.onTap = onAnswer -> _openForm(pendingForm) -> presentConnectionForm(context, _conn, form) (chat/form_flow.dart:23); guarded by _activeFormID.

elements.label: Answer
elements.effect: FilledButton.tonal onPressed = onAnswer -> _openForm(pendingForm) -> presentConnectionForm.

elements.label: [queued drafts / inbox items strip: edit, resend, discard, cancel inbox, flip delivery]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _PendingSendsStrip (chat/message_view.dart:2401): onEdit -> _editQueuedPrompt (moves the queued draft back into the composer), onResend -> _resendQueuedPrompt (confirm sheet then _conn.resendQueuedPrompt), onDiscard -> _discardQueuedPrompt (confirm sheet), onCancelInbox -> _cancelInboxSend (confirm sheet then _conn.cancelInboxItem), onFlipDelivery -> _flipInboxDelivery (_conn.setInboxDelivery). Handlers are in lines 2267-2425 (b1).

elements.label: <photo name | "Pending photo">
elements.effect: _reviewPendingPhoto(photo): _conn.promptPhotos.readPending(id) then showFilePreviewSheet of the recovered photo. Disabled while _photoBusy.

elements.label: Add recovered photo to draft
elements.effect: _applyPendingPhoto(photo): attaches the recovered camera/gallery photo to the draft (text-only connections get a composer note). Disabled while _promptShelfBusy.

elements.label: Discard pending photo
elements.effect: _discardPendingPhoto(photo): _conn.promptPhotos.discard(photo.id). Disabled while _photoBusy. No confirmation.

elements.label: Copy
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData(_composer.text); disabled when the composer is empty.

elements.label: Retry saving draft
elements.effect: _retryDraftPersistence(): re-runs _recoverDraftAttachments() when blocked, then _persistDraft(). Disabled while _restoringDraftAttachments.

elements.label: Move running work to background | Background subagents (tooltip: "Continue this work while you use the chat · Ctrl+B")
elements.effect: _backgroundRunningWork() (line 1235): repository.backgroundSession(sessionID), then reloads transcript, sessions and running shells. Disabled (spinner) while _backgrounding.

elements.label: [voice conversation controls]
elements.effect: Embeds _voiceConversationControls() (chat/voice_conversation.dart:377); its buttons belong to that part file.

elements.label: [drop files onto composer (desktop)]
elements.effect: DesktopFileDropTarget.onDrop -> _handleDroppedFiles: each file (<= 10 MB, max count and 20 MB aggregate) goes through _addPreviewAttachment into _attachments.

elements.label: [inline slash command suggestion]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onSelectCommand -> _selectChatCommand(command): server commands are typed into the composer as "/<name> "; built-in commands run _runMobileCommand(action) (see chat-command-launcher-sheet command elements).

elements.label: [inline @agent suggestion]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onSelectAgent -> _insertAgentMention(agent) inserts @<agent> into the prompt.

elements.label: [commands]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onOpenCommands -> _openCommandLauncher(): refreshes the catalog (_conn.refreshCatalog() when capabilities.serverCatalog) and shows _CommandLauncherSheet on the Commands tab.

elements.label: [agents]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onOpenAgents -> _openCommandLauncher(initialTab: _ComposerToolTab.agents).

elements.label: [prompt editor]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onOpenEditor -> _openPromptEditor() (line 3319) pushes _PromptEditorScreen and applies the result to the composer.

elements.label: [reuse recent prompt]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onReusePrompt -> _reusePrompt() (line 875) shows _PromptHistorySheet(prompts: _recentPrompts).

elements.label: [clear draft text]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onClearText -> _clearDraftText() (line 1164).

elements.label: [stash current prompt]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onStashPrompt -> _stashCurrentPrompt() (line 953): _conn.savePromptStash(snapshot).

elements.label: [open prompt stash]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onOpenStash -> _openPromptStash() (line 1005) shows _PromptStashSheet; restoring may ask via showConfirmSheet.

elements.label: [restore draft after prompt-history browse]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onRestoreHistoryDraft -> _restoreHistoryDraft() (line 917).

elements.label: [delivery mode: steer / queue]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onDeliveryChanged -> setState(_delivery = delivery).

elements.label: [attach file]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onAttach -> _pickAttachment() (line 3013): system file picker, adds PromptAttachment.

elements.label: [photo library]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onPhotoLibrary -> _pickPhoto(ImageSource.gallery) (line 3093).

elements.label: [camera]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onCamera -> _pickPhoto(ImageSource.camera).

elements.label: [IME image/GIF insertion or clipboard-image paste chip]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onContentInserted -> _handleInsertedContent(content) (line 3232) attaches the inserted image.

elements.label: [voice input]
elements.effect: onVoice -> ChatScreen._openVoice(): the voice model setup sheet when no model is ready; otherwise voice is a composer mode (slice-P10.3, 3273d7ef) and dictation lands in the draft; no voice sheet opens.

elements.label: [voice conversation]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onConversation -> _startVoiceConversation() (chat/voice_conversation.dart:85).

elements.label: [add web sources]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onWebSources -> _addWebSources() (line 2878) pushes WebSourcesScreen(controller: _conn) and merges the result into the draft.

elements.label: [Send]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onSend -> _send() (line 2425). canSendWhileBusy: !_voiceConversation.

elements.label: [Stop]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onStop -> _abort() (line 3383): aborts the running turn through the action transport; stopping: _aborting.

elements.label: <model label | "Server default" | "Loading session selection…">
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onChooseModel -> showModelPicker(context, applyScope: ModelPickerApplyScope.session, sessionID).

elements.label: [model cycle button: next / previous / favorite]
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): modelSwitch: _modelCycleButton() returns ModelCycleButton(onCycle: _cycleModel) (lib/ui/widgets/model_shortcuts.dart:65): _conn.cycleModelForSession(sessionID, reverse, favoritesOnly); snackbar "Next turns in this session use {model}."

elements.label: <attachment chip> remove
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onRemoveAttachment -> setState(_attachments.remove(attachment)).

elements.label: <staged review reference chip> remove
elements.effect: Host wiring of _ChatComposer (chat/composer.dart:21): onRemoveReference -> _removeStagedReference -> _handoff.store.remove(sessionID, reference.id).

elements.label: Ctrl+K (OpenCommandPaletteIntent)
elements.effect: onAppShortcut: in a session the palette intent opens the chat command launcher (_openCommandLauncher()) instead of the shell palette; isolated sessions swallow it.

elements.label: Ctrl+F (FindInSurfaceIntent)
elements.effect: Actions handler -> _openFind(): shows the transcript find bar.

elements.label: Esc
elements.effect: _closeFind().

elements.label: F3 / Shift+F3
elements.effect: _navigateFind(1) / _navigateFind(-1).

elements.label: F2 / Shift+F2 (ModelShortcuts)
elements.effect: ModelShortcuts.onCycle -> _cycleModel(reverse:) -> _conn.cycleModelForSession(sessionID).

elements.label: Ctrl+B (ModelShortcuts)
elements.effect: ModelShortcuts.onBackground -> _backgroundRunningWork() -> repository.backgroundSession(sessionID).

pages.title: [Message actions]
pages.purpose: Long-press actions for one transcript message: copy, fork, read aloud, revert, delete.

elements.label: Copy message text | Copy reply so far | Copy loaded reply | Copy complete reply
elements.effect: Pops 'copy' -> _copyMessageText(message): clipboard + snackbar "Message text copied".

elements.label: Fork from this prompt (subtitle: Start a new session with this prompt in the composer)
elements.effect: Pops 'fork' -> _forkFromMessage(message): repository.forkSession(sessionID, messageID), refreshSessions, pushReplacement ChatScreen(new id, initialText, initialAttachments).

elements.label: Read reply prose
elements.effect: Pops 'readAloud' -> _readReply(message) (chat/read_aloud.dart:168) speaks the reply prose.

elements.label: Read with another voice
elements.effect: Pops 'readAloudOtherVoice' -> _readReply(message, chooseVoice: true).

elements.label: Revert from this prompt
elements.effect: Pops 'revert' -> _stageFromMessage(message): showStageRevertSheet; on confirm _conn.stageSessionRevert(review, messageID, applyFiles) and push StagedRevertScreen.

elements.label: Delete message (subtitle: Removes it from the conversation permanently)
elements.effect: Pops 'delete' -> _deleteMessage(message) opens the delete confirm sheet.

pages.title: Delete this message?
pages.purpose: Destructive confirmation (showConfirmSheet) before permanently deleting one message.

elements.label: Delete message
elements.effect: repository.deleteMessage(sessionID, messageID); removes it locally, snackbar "Message deleted", then _load(resetHistory: true).

elements.label: [Cancel] (showConfirmSheet default)
elements.effect: Closes the sheet; nothing is deleted.

pages.title: Revert from this prompt?
pages.purpose: Confirmation before the non-staged (OpenCode 1) revert of the most recent prompt.
gates: a non-local, non-inbox user message exists

elements.label: Revert
elements.effect: repository.revertSession(sessionID, target.info.id) then _load(resetHistory: true). Message: "Messages and file changes after the most recent prompt will be rolled back."

elements.label: [Cancel] (showConfirmSheet default)
elements.effect: Closes the sheet.

pages.title: Run shell command
pages.purpose: AlertDialog that takes one shell command and runs it in the session.

elements.label: $ e.g. npm test
elements.effect: Autofocused TextField for the command; no onSubmitted.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(ctx).

elements.label: Run
elements.effect: Pops the trimmed text; _runShellDialog then calls api.shell(sessionID, command, agent: session agent or 'build', model, variant) via _conn.prepareActionTransport(); errors via showProductError.

pages.title: Commands
pages.purpose: Searchable launcher of built-in mobile slash commands, server commands and subagents; the sheet widget lives in chat/command_launcher.dart, the command catalog (_chatCommands, line 4609) and execution (_executeMobileCommand, line 5098) live in chat_screen.dart.

elements.label: /new (aliases: clear) — New session
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _persistDraft(), _conn.createSession(), _discardUntouchedMobileSession(), _conn.refreshSessions(), pushReplacementNamed(/chat/<newId>, arguments: ChatRouteArguments.newlyCreated()).

elements.label: /sessions (resume, continue) — Sessions
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes GlobalSessionsScreen(controller: _conn).

elements.label: /workspaces (workspace) — Projects and workspaces
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes HomeScreen(initialTab: 0).

elements.label: /move — Move session
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: showSessionDestinationSheet(controller, sessionID, mode: SessionDestinationMode.move).

elements.label: /warp — Move session (experimental workspace)
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: showSessionDestinationSheet(mode: SessionDestinationMode.warp).

elements.label: /editor — Prompt editor
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _openPromptEditor() pushes _PromptEditorScreen.

elements.label: /files (open) — Project files
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes an inline Scaffold(AppBar "Project files") hosting FilesScreen(controller, onAttachFile: _attachProjectFile, onReviewPrompt: _addReviewPrompt, handoff: _handoff) (line 5142).

elements.label: /health — Project health
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _conn.prepareActionRepository() then pushes ProjectHealthScreen(repository, repositoryResolver, capabilities).

elements.label: /terminal — Terminal
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes TerminalScreen(controller: _conn).

elements.label: /models (model, mo) — Model
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: showModelPicker(applyScope: session, sessionID).

elements.label: /agents (agent) — Agent
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Same _ChatCommandAction.model: showModelPicker.

elements.label: /variants — Thinking mode
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Same _ChatCommandAction.model: showModelPicker.

elements.label: /mcps (mcp) — MCP servers
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher or as an inline suggestion -> _executeMobileCommand(_ChatCommandAction.mcpServers): pushes IntegrationsScreen(controller: _conn, mode: IntegrationsMode.mcp), the hub's MCP screen.

elements.label: /connect — Connect provider
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher or as an inline suggestion -> _executeMobileCommand(_ChatCommandAction.integrations): pushes IntegrationsScreen(controller: _conn, mode: IntegrationsMode.providers), the hub's Providers screen.

elements.label: /org (orgs, switch-org) — Switch organization
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: showConsoleOrganizationSheet(context, controller: _conn).

elements.label: /skills — Skills
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes SkillsScreen(controller, sessionID when _conn.supportsSessionSkills); a true result shows note "Skill added to this conversation." and reloads.

elements.label: /tools — Tools and capabilities
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher or as an inline suggestion -> _executeMobileCommand: pushes CapabilitiesScreen(controller: _conn, initialTab: 1), the hub's Commands & tools screen on its Tools tab.

elements.label: /references (reference, refs) — Project references
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes ReferencesScreen(controller, onSelected: _attachReference) which adds a directory reference attachment and an @name mention.

elements.label: /status — Server status
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher or as an inline suggestion -> _executeMobileCommand: pushes ServerSettingsScreen(controller: _conn), the Settings hub's Connection > This server screen.

elements.label: /debug — App diagnostics
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: Pushes AppDiagnosticsScreen(controller: _conn).

elements.label: /themes (theme) — Appearance
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher or as an inline suggestion -> _executeMobileCommand: pushes AppearanceSettingsScreen(controller: _conn), the Settings hub's Appearance screen.

elements.label: /diff — Session changes
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _showDiff(): pushes ReviewWorkspace(handoff, loadDiffs: api.diff(sessionID), loadWorkingTreeDiffs / loadBranchDiffs: repository.listVcsDiffs); a returned prompt is appended to the composer via _addReviewPrompt.

elements.label: /context (usage) — Session context
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _showContext(): pushes SessionContextScreen(controller, sessionID, initialMessages, initialHasOlder).
gates: enabled: any assistant message with tokens.total > 0

elements.label: /share — Share session | Copy share link
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: When _shareUrl == null calls _share() (line 3413: showConfirmSheet "Share this session?" then repository.shareSession and copy link); otherwise copies _shareUrl and shows snackbar "Share link copied".

elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _stopSharing(): repository.unshareSession(sessionID), refreshSessions, snackbar.

elements.label: /rename — Rename session
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _renameCurrentSession() opens the rename dialog.

elements.label: /timeline (messages) — Message timeline
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _openTimeline() shows _TimelineSheet.

elements.label: /fork — Fork from prompt
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _openTimeline(forkMode: true); choosing a prompt calls _forkFromMessage.

elements.label: /compact (summarize) — Compact context
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _compact(): repository.compactSession(sessionID, providerID, modelID); snackbar "Compaction started".

elements.label: /thinking (toggle-thinking) — Collapse reasoning | Expand reasoning
elements.effect: Selected in the launcher (onSelected pops the sheet, line 5059) or as an inline composer suggestion -> _selectChatCommand -> _executeMobileCommand: _toggleReasoningDisplay(): clears per-part reasoning overrides and _conn.setTranscriptReasoningExpanded(!current); snackbar.

elements.label: /timestamps (toggle-timestamps) — Hide timestamps | Show timestamps
